evals.prompt:
Please create a practice set for me (practice-builder skill).
- What do you want to practise: Grammar, Speaking
- Which grammar points: P1-02 Present simple: affirmative, P1-03 Present simple: negatives & questions (do/does)
- How do you want to speak: Role-play
- Which topics: Housing
- How hard: My level
- How much time do you have: 20 min
- Which kinds of exercises: tutor's choice
- Anything else: tutor's choice

Choices (JSON): {"skills":["grammar","speaking"],"grammar":["P1-02","P1-03"],"speaking":["roleplay"],"topics":["housing"],"level":"level","time":"20"}
evals.expected_output: Writes materials/generated/practice/<date>-<slug>.md and answers/<id>.md following the template: a short Quick look on present simple affirmative and negatives/questions, 12–16 new numbered gap/choice/find-the-mistake items about housing (one ___ per item, numbered without gaps), a 'Your turn · Speaking' flat-viewing role-play task, 1–2 live direct links. The key has one line per scored item. The chat reply is 2–4 lines in simple English and ends with [[open:practice:<id>]]; no answers shown.
